decisions.reason: Because it builds on the firm's core wafer-substrate and process-integration knowledge and the firm has strong in-house R&D and research links, management is likely to keep it and learn its way through early market feedback despite its somewhat higher technical complexity.

This carrier wafer is very close to the firm's established handling and packaging wafer business, so with existing know-how, customer fit and R&D capability, management would be unlikely to withdraw it after only one year.
